title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.12586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Event sequences are chains of random events, each described by heterogeneous (numerical and categorical) features. The problem of event sequence forecasting occurs in finance, healthcare, business process intelligence, and other fields. In this work, we study multi-horizon forecasting of event sequences as a conditional generative modeling problem. We evaluate forecasts not only for prediction accuracy, but also for distributional realism. To this end, we present a benchmark comprising metrics for both quality aspects, strong statistical baselines, recent models adapted from adjacent fields, and curated real-world datasets. translated_title: 真实性 VS 准确性：从生成建模视角看事件序列预测
translated_abstract: 事件序列是由随机事件组成的链条，每个事件由异构（数值型和类别型）特征描述。事件序列预测问题出现在金融、医疗保健、业务流程智能等领域。在这项工作中，我们将事件序列的多步预测研究为一个条件生成建模问题。我们不仅从预测准确性方面评估预测结果，还从分布真实性方面进行评估。为此，我们提出了一个基准，包含针对这两方面质量的度量指标、强大的统计基线模型、从相邻领域借鉴的近期模型，以及精选的真实世界数据集。细致的评估表明，没有任何方法能在准确性和真实性两方面都表现出色，这凸显了两者之间根本性的权衡。最后，我们提出了Wasserstein BaryBooster，这是一种将来自真实性强的扩散模型的样本聚合到最先进预测器中的算法，证明了分布（原文在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出从条件生成建模视角研究事件序列多步预测，构建了同时评估预测准确性与分布真实性的基准，揭示了两者之间的根本性权衡，并提出Wasserstein BaryBooster算法，将真实性强的扩散模型样本聚合到最先进的预测器中。
en_tdlr: This paper studies multi-horizon event sequence forecasting as a conditional generative modeling problem, introduces a benchmark evaluating both prediction accuracy and distributional realism, reveals a fundamental trade-off between the two, and proposes Wasserstein BaryBooster, an algorithm that aggregates samples from a realism-strong diffusion model into a state-of-the-art predictor.
